title: [DEV] AAPSClient occasionally dont show updated BG from NS (V3+WS)
body:
AAPSClient 3.2.0-dev-l
Build: f717d7a0b2-2023.09.16
Remote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS
Flavor: aapsclientrelease
Nightscout version: 15.0.0

Random BG + Upload to BS

See attached screenshots and logs.

BG recieved in NSclient BG with timestamp 14:55 not showing in AAPSClient screen. Next BG both values gets updated in overview screen. This behaviour is not present in master. I've seen this happen several times, seems like the chance is higher if you enact a profile change from AAPSclient.

Workaround: Exit and open AAPSClient again.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1694955520702.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12642875/AndroidAPS_LOG_1694955520702.log.zip)
